content:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#
# Runs the flake checks on Linux and Darwin, and the two
# conformance checks of the purifier contract that need the network or a
# Nix installation, which the Nix sandbox has neither of: a relock of a
# fixture, and the offline loop after a real `maven-purifier prefetch`.
name: check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Record and verify the native runtime platform
        run: bash tests/native-platform.sh
      - name: Run the flake checks
        run: nix flake check --print-build-logs
      - name: Record successful Gson runtime derivations
        run: |
          system=$(nix eval --impure --raw --expr builtins.currentSystem)
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson-evidence"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson-evidence/source.txt"
          nix build --no-link --json \
            ".#checks.$system.real-world-gson-tests" \
            ".#checks.$system.real-world-gson-offline" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson-evidence/builds.json"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson-evidence" <<'PYTHON'
          import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          builds = json.loads((root / 'builds.json').read_text())
          outputs = [output for build in builds for output in build['outputs'].values()]
          (root / 'outputs.json').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['nix', 'path-info', '--json', *outputs]))
          (root / 'derivations.json').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(
              ['nix', 'derivation', 'show', *[build['drvPath'] for build in builds]]))
          (root / 'system.txt').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(
              ['nix', 'eval', '--impure', '--raw', '--expr', 'builtins.currentSystem']))
          (root / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(['real-world-gson-tests', 'real-world-gson-offline']))
          sandbox = subprocess.check_output(['nix', 'config', 'show', 'sandbox'], text=True).strip()
          assert sandbox == 'true', f'Expected sandbox=true, got {sandbox}'
          (root / 'sandbox.txt').write_text(sandbox + '\n')
          for output in outputs:
              for name in ['toolchain.txt', 'tests.txt', 'missing-artifact.log']:
                  path = pathlib.Path(output) / name
                  if path.is_file():
                      (root / name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
          PYTHON
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: gson-evidence-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gson-evidence

  conformance-relock:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Record and verify the native runtime platform
        run: bash tests/native-platform.sh
      - name: Build the command
        run: nix build --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli" '.#cli'
      - name: Relock copies of fixtures, which must reproduce their lockfiles byte for byte
        run: |
          # An empty home, so that no settings of the runner take part.
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/home"
          cp -r tests/fixtures/wrapper "$RUNNER_TEMP/wrapper"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/wrapper" && HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" lock --force)
          diff -u tests/fixtures/wrapper/maven-purifier.lock.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/wrapper/maven-purifier.lock.json"
          cp -r tests/fixtures/external "$RUNNER_TEMP/external"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/external/src" && HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" lock --force --lockfile ../maven-purifier.lock.json)
          diff -u tests/fixtures/external/maven-purifier.lock.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/external/maven-purifier.lock.json"
      - name: Lock, relock, prefetch and test Gson with ordinary Maven
        run: |
          git clone --quiet https://github.com/google/gson "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson"
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson" checkout --quiet fcd416909db2bea96eb916bcfb2d0a83cb9b86c3
          cp tests/real-world/gson/maven-purifier.lock.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson.lock.json"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson" && HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" lock --force --lockfile ../gson.lock.json)
          diff -u tests/real-world/gson/maven-purifier.lock.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson.lock.json"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson"
          HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" lock --force --lockfile ../gson.lock.json
          diff -u "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tests/real-world/gson/maven-purifier.lock.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gson.lock.json"
          HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" prefetch --lockfile ../gson.lock.json
          export JAVA_HOME="$PWD/.maven-purifier/jdk"
          export PATH="$PWD/.maven-purifier/bin:$PATH"
          mvn --version
          HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" mvn -B -ntp clean install
          python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tests/real-world/gson/check-reports.py" .
          # Maven must fail rather than fall back to a remote repository.
          junit=.maven-purifier/repository/junit/junit/4.13.2/junit-4.13.2.jar
          test -f "$junit"
          mv "$junit" "$RUNNER_TEMP/withheld-junit.jar"
          if HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" mvn -B -ntp -pl gson test > "$RUNNER_TEMP/missing-artifact.log" 2>&1; then
            echo 'Maven accepted a missing locked test dependency' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/missing-artifact.log"
          grep -i 'offline' "$RUNNER_TEMP/missing-artifact.log"
          grep 'junit:junit' "$RUNNER_TEMP/missing-artifact.log"
          mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/withheld-junit.jar" "$junit"

  conformance-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Record and verify the native runtime platform
        run: bash tests/native-platform.sh
      - name: Build the command
        run: nix build --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli" '.#cli'
      - name: Update a copy of the multi fixture to a newer commons-lang3
        run: |
          cp -r tests/fixtures/multi "$RUNNER_TEMP/multi"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/multi"
          sed -i 's|<version>3.17.0</version>|<version>3.18.0</version>|' pom.xml
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/home"
          HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/home" "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" update
          grep -q 'commons-lang3-3.18.0.jar' maven-purifier.lock.json
          # The updated lockfile passes the stale check: readLock reports
          # no problem for it.
          problems=$(nix eval --impure --json --expr "
            ((builtins.getFlake \"path:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE\").lib.maven-purifier.readLock {
              src = /. + \"$RUNNER_TEMP/multi\";
            }).problems")
          test "$problems" = "[]"

  conformance-offline:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Record and verify the native runtime platform
        run: bash tests/native-platform.sh
      - name: Build the command, jdtls and Python
        run: |
          nix build --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli" '.#cli'
          nix build --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/jdtls" 'nixpkgs#jdt-language-server'
          nix build --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/python" 'nixpkgs#python3'
      - name: Prefetch a copy of the multi fixture
        run: |
          cp -r tests/fixtures/multi "$RUNNER_TEMP/multi"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/multi"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" prefetch
      - name: Lock and use a Nix-built JVM dependency
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/python/bin/python3" tests/composition-native.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier"
      - name: Capture and replay an online-marked goal without resolver fallback
        run: >-
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/python/bin/python3" tests/online-goal-native.py
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier"
      - name: Build, test and open the editor with the network cut off
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/multi"
          # A network namespace without interfaces: nothing reaches the
          # network, and the steps run as the runner's own user.
          offline() {
            sudo unshare --net -- sudo -u "$USER" env HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" \
              JAVA_HOME="$PWD/.maven-purifier/jdk" "$@"
          }
          offline .maven-purifier/bin/mvn -B -ntp clean install
          offline "$RUNNER_TEMP/python/bin/python3" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tests/ide/jdtls_check.py" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/jdtls/bin/jdtls" . .maven-purifier/settings.xml \
            core/src/main/java/example/multi/core/Greeting.java
      - name: Name `maven-purifier lock` for a stale lock
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/multi"
          sed -i 's|<version>1.0.0</version>|<version>1.0.1</version>|' core/pom.xml
          if "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" prefetch 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/stale.log"; then
            echo "prefetch accepted a stale lock" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          grep -F 'run `maven-purifier lock`' "$RUNNER_TEMP/stale.log"

  compatibility:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { maven: '2.2.1', java: '8' }
          - { maven: '3.0.5', java: '8' }
          - { maven: '3.3.9', java: '17' }
          - { maven: '3.8.8', java: '17' }
          - { maven: '3.9.11', java: '17' }
          - { maven: '4.0.0-rc-7', java: '17' }
          - { maven: '3.9.16', java: '17' }
          - { maven: '3.10.0', java: '17' }
          - { maven: '3.9.16', java: '17', runner: macos-15 }
          - { maven: '3.10.0', java: '17', runner: macos-15 }
          - { maven: '4.0.0-rc-7', java: '17', runner: macos-15 }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            sandbox = true
      - name: Record and verify the native runtime platform
        run: bash tests/native-platform.sh
      - name: Build the purifier and the matching JDK
        run: |
          nix build '.#cli' --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli"
          nix build --inputs-from . 'nixpkgs#jdk${{ matrix.java }}_headless' --out-link "$RUNNER_TEMP/jdk"
      - name: Lock, relock, work offline and build in the sandbox
        env:
          MAVEN_PURIFIER_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/compatibility-evidence
        run: >-
          python3 tests/compatibility/check.py '${{ matrix.maven }}'
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin/maven-purifier" "$RUNNER_TEMP/jdk"
      - name: Bind the runtime receipts to the source revision
        run: git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/compatibility-evidence/source.txt"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: maven-${{ matrix.maven }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/compatibility-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
